logline: A disgraced STG officer goes undercover in the Kashmir Valley in 2017 to dismantle a Pakistan-backed terror network - India's official adaptation of the Israeli series Fauda.

bollymeter.basis: Individual episode IMDb ratings cluster in the 7.9-8.4 range; critics at Times of India and Scroll.in praised the breakneck pacing and striking Kashmir cinematography, while Hindustan Times and Film Companion flagged the adaptation's unwillingness to interrogate the conflict from multiple angles.

pull_quotes.text: A nail-biting espionage thriller set in Kashmir that moves at a breakneck pace throughout.
The show delivers the sugar rush of a fast-paced action thriller.

seasons.review_body: Tanaav premiered on SonyLIV on November 11, 2022 - India's official adaptation of the Israeli action thriller Fauda, transposed from the West Bank to the Kashmir Valley in 2017. Directors Sachin Krishn and Sudhir Mishra established the show's register immediately: kinetic editing, authentic Kashmiri locations and dialogue, and a relentless operational momentum borrowed from its Israeli source. Times of India called it a nail-biting espionage thriller that moves at a breakneck pace. Scroll.in noted it as an undoubtedly gripping thriller but cautioned that it rushes past the important questions about the conflict it depicts. Episode ratings on IMDb sit between 7.9 and 8.4, indicating consistent audience engagement across the twelve-episode run.

episode_reviews.title: Resurrection
episode_reviews.review_body: Tanaav Season 1 Episode 1 'Resurrection' aired November 11, 2022 on SonyLIV as the premiere of the 12-episode first season. Times of India called the series 'a nail-biting espionage thriller that moves at a breakneck pace'; Scroll.in praised it as 'undoubtedly gripping.' The premiere resets the Fauda adaptation's premise for the Kashmir Valley in 2017: a burned STG operative pulled back into the field he knows too well, facing an enemy who exploits both the terrain and institutional fractures within the service. Directors Sachin Krishn and Sudhir Mishra use authentic Kashmiri locations and dialogue to deliver a tactical realism the Israeli original brought to the West Bank. The opening field operation communicates what the STG is willing to do, the costs it accepts, and the institutional damage those costs produce - and sets the pace for the twelve-episode run.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere resets the premise cleanly: a burned operative pulled back into the field in a region he knows too well, facing an enemy who exploits both the terrain and the institutional fractures within the STG. The Kashmir setting is deployed without exoticization.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The opening field operation that establishes what the STG is willing to do - and what its costs will be.

episode_reviews.title: An Eye For An Eye
episode_reviews.review_body: Tanaav Season 1 Episode 6 'An Eye For An Eye' aired November 11, 2022 on SonyLIV. Times of India called the series 'a nail-biting espionage thriller'; Film Companion praised 'the sugar rush of a fast-paced action thriller.' Episode 6 is the season's highest-rated episode on IMDb, building the personal stakes the procedural opening deliberately underplayed. The title announces the episode's moral logic plainly: retaliation as principle, with the operational and personal cost of that logic made visible. The Kashmir insurgency context, drawn from documented events of 2017, gives the episode's confrontations the weight of a storyline operating alongside a known history rather than against an invented one. The episode represents the series at its fullest expression of what the Fauda adaptation formula can achieve in its transposed setting.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The season's mid-point is its highest-rated episode on IMDb, building the personal stakes that the procedural opening had deliberately underplayed. The episode's title announces its moral logic plainly, and the show follows through.

bollymeter.basis: Season 2 episode IMDb ratings trend slightly lower (7.4-8.4 range); the Kashmiri conflict backdrop remains visually strong but some episodes show the plotting fatigue that long-running action serials encounter in their second cycle.

seasons.review_body: Season 2 premiered in two batches - six episodes on September 6, 2024, and the remaining six on December 6, 2024 - with an expanded cast that added Arbaaz Khan, Arslan Goni, and Soni Razdan alongside returning leads Manav Vij and Rajat Kapoor. The split-release format kept the show in conversation across the final quarter of 2024. Episode IMDb ratings dip modestly from Season 1 peaks, with the stronger entries still landing in the 8.0-8.4 range but the mid-season episodes trailing lower. The season maintains the visual quality and operational authenticity that critics credited in Season 1 while deepening the personal arcs. For committed viewers of the first season, the second continues what it promises; for new viewers, Season 1 is the correct entry point.
seasons.season_over_season: Expands the ensemble and splits its run across two release windows; slightly lower episode-by-episode audience scores but a consistent action-thriller tone.
